# Amsterdam trip guide: 2027-06-02 – 2027-06-05

One adult travelling from Oulu to Amsterdam for a 3‑night, 4‑day stay. Mid‑budget tier with a total budget of **€700**. Interests: art and cycling. The weather description is based on typical observations for these dates (all days rainy), not a forecast.

> **Important**
> - Your outbound flight arrives at 20:50 on Wed 2 Jun, so most of the first day is lost. Finnair at 09:45 costs €18 more for the group (€173 in total) and keeps most of the day.

## Getting there and back

**Outbound (Oulu → Amsterdam)**

> **Note:** The cheapest outbound involves a self‑transfer between airlines in Helsinki and Stockholm; allow extra time for ticket checks.

**Return (Amsterdam → Oulu)**

| **Fastest** | flight | Finnair | 2027‑06‑05 11:55 → 2027‑06‑05 16:55 | 4 h 0 m | 1 | €255 (live) | [Kiwi](https://kiwi.com/u/32c9qqrcsv) |

> **Note:** The return leg includes a long layover in Helsinki; be prepared for an overnight‑style connection.

## Where to stay

Travellers stay in their own place; no accommodation is needed.

## Day by day

*Days in this plan start around 09:30 and end by 22:00, at a balanced pace (the defaults). For another rhythm, tell the concierge, e.g. "we wake up early, start at 07:00", "we stay out late" or "a more relaxed pace, please".*

### Day 1 – Wed 2027-06-02: Museum Quarter
*Weather:* rain, 14‑20 °C • Walking: – km

- **20:50 Arrive in Amsterdam** – Flight with Finnair, Norwegian Air Sweden. See *Getting there and back*.
- **21:30 De Blauwe Hollander** – Dutch home‑cooked comfort food (herrings, pea soup, hutspot). Mid‑budget, price around €20. [http://www.deblauwehollander.nl](http://www.deblauwehollander.nl)

### Day 2 – Thu 2027-06-03: Canal Ring
*Weather:* rain, 12‑18 °C • Walking: 2.7 km

- **10:00 Foam Fotografiemuseum Amsterdam** – A photography museum on Keizersgracht offering changing exhibitions of documentary, art and fashion photography. Hours: Th‑Fr 10:00‑21:00. Ticket: *ticket price: see the website*. [https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/250624672](https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/250624672)
- **12:30 Magere Brug** – The iconic skinny wooden drawbridge over the Amstel, first built in 1691 and rebuilt in 1934; a favourite photo spot for cyclists. Free entry. [https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Amsterdam/Canal_District](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Amsterdam/Canal_District)
- **14:00 Rijksmuseum** – The national museum housing around 8,000 objects, including Rembrandt’s *Night Watch* and Vermeer’s *Girl with a Pearl Earring*. Hours: 09:00‑17:00 daily. Ticket €26.5. [https://www.rijksmuseum.nl/en/visit](https://www.rijksmuseum.nl/en/visit)
- **17:30 La Margarita** – Caribbean plates such as rice, beans, plantains and vegetables. High‑budget, €20‑30 per person. [https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Amsterdam/Canal_District](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Amsterdam/Canal_District)

### Day 3 – Fri 2027-06-04: Jordaan
*Weather:* light rain, 13‑18 °C • Walking: 4.5 km

- **10:00 Museum Het Grachtenhuis** – Multimedia exhibition telling the story of Amsterdam’s 17th‑century Canal District and its urban planning. Ticket €12. [https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Amsterdam/Canal_District](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Amsterdam/Canal_District)
- **12:00 Anne Frank House** – Museum in the building where Anne Frank wrote her diary; includes the Secret Annex and a permanent exhibition. Hours: 09:00‑22:00. Ticket €16. [http://www.annefrank.org/](http://www.annefrank.org/)
- **15:00 Van Gogh Museum** – Home to the world‑largest collection of Vincent van Gogh’s paintings and drawings. Hours: Fri 09:00‑22:00. Ticket: *ticket price: see the website*. [https://www.vangoghmuseum.nl/en/visit/tickets-and-ticket-prices](https://www.vangoghmuseum.nl/en/visit/tickets-and-ticket-prices)
- **17:30 Damsteeg** – Modern fish‑focused restaurant with meat and vegetarian options. Mid‑budget. [https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Amsterdam/Canal_District](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Amsterdam/Canal_District)
- **21:00 Pancakes! Amsterdam** – Wide variety of sweet and savoury Dutch pancakes. Low‑budget. [http://www.pancakesamsterdam.com/](http://www.pancakesamsterdam.com/)

### Day 4 – Sat 2027-06-05: North
*Weather:* rain, 12‑18 °C • Walking: 1.4 km

- **10:30 Eye Filmmuseum** – Film archive and museum on the north bank of the IJ, offering exhibitions and screenings on film history and technology. Hours: 10:00‑19:00 daily. Ticket: *ticket price: see the website*. [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/EYE_Institut_Filmmuseum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/EYE_Institut_Filmmuseum)
- **13:00 Kinnaree** – Thai restaurant; recommended dishes are the green curry and pad thai. Mid‑budget. [http://www.restaurantkinnaree.nl](http://www.restaurantkinnaree.nl)
- **19:25 Depart from Amsterdam** – Flight with Finnair. See *Getting there and back*.

## Food to try

- **Stamppot** – A traditional Dutch one‑pot meal of mashed potatoes mixed with vegetables, often served with smoked sausage. [https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Netherlands#Eat](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Netherlands#Eat)
- **Hutspot** – A variant of stamppot made with carrots, onions and potatoes, classic Dutch comfort food. [https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Netherlands#Eat](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Netherlands#Eat)
- **Haring (soused herring)** – Raw herring served with chopped onion, often in a bun. [https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Netherlands#Eat](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Netherlands#Eat)
- **Pannenkoeken** – Large Dutch pancakes, sweet with syrup or savoury with cheese and bacon. [https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Netherlands#Eat](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Netherlands#Eat)
- **Stroopwafels** – Thin waffle cookies filled with caramel‑like syrup, a classic sweet treat. [https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Netherlands#Eat](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Netherlands#Eat)
- **Poffertjes** – Small fluffy mini‑pancakes dusted with powdered sugar and butter, popular at street stalls. [https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Netherlands#Eat](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Netherlands#Eat)
- **Erwtensoep** – Thick split‑pea soup, traditionally eaten in winter, often enriched with pork. [https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Netherlands#Eat](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Netherlands#Eat)
